goal: Read redteam/world.py first and use ONLY its API (World.new_client / add_tx / new_ext_account / label / random_time, w.rng is a numpy Generator, w.banks the bank ids). Docstring must cite the scheme as 'planted red-team scheme, synthetic, designed from public descriptions of Czech/CEE money-mule schemes'. Every client you create must get exactly one w.label(...) call. All timestamps are tz-aware UTC datetimes between 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-31. Amounts in CZK. Signature must be exactly as stated. Do not read tests other than the named test file. Create redteam/schemes/day_zero.py with `plant_day_zero(w: World, n: int = 5, instance: int = 0) -> None` (also import World from redteam.world). For each of n accounts: bank = random choice of w.banks; contract_date = 1..40 days before 2026-07-01 (tz UTC); contract_form 'in person' with prob 0.6 else 'distant form'; expected_volume 20000..60000; q2_volume=0, q2_count=0, q2_max=0 (pass these args); 0..2 small 'life' transactions (500..3000 CZK, direction 'out' to a new ext account) before the event. EVENT: one big inflow 150000..600000 CZK on a random day 3..25 (use w.random_time(3,25)) from 1..3 third-party payers (new ext accounts; split the amount; the single largest inflow must be >=100000 so make the first part >=100000 when split in several). Then within 24 hours AFTER the largest inflow: outflows totalling 92..99% of the inflow amount, split into 1..4 transactions (each at least 1 minute after the largest inflow), direction 'out' or 'remit_out' (remit_out about 40%), to rare exit accounts (new ext accounts, countries random among CZ,SK,DE,LT,BG). Label every account w.label(cid,'mule','day_zero',instance=instance).
